text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Tunisia, Libya held security talks in Tunis. Libyan Public Order Minister Mohamed al-Hegazi expressed Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi's thanks to President Ben Ali for Tunisia's mediation between Tripoli and Nouakchott.
- Cars "Polo" and "Clio" models at reduced tax fees arrive. Prices range between 9,500 dinars and 9,800 dinars.
- Tunisian Pharmaceutical products to be exhibited in Tripoli on March 29-30.
- Tunisia and Jordan to boost bilateral cooperation on trade exchanges.
- Tunisia and Netherlands to speed up partnership in trade and investment. Netherland's Foreign Trade Minister Van Weel received by Tunisian Prime Minister Karoui on Tuesday.
- Tunisia to import 10,000 cars to be sold at reduced tax fees in 1997.
